question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Fastidious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Fastidious"** means showing or demanding excessive care or attention to detail; being very particular and hard to please. (अत्यधिक चुस्त, सूक्ष्म और कठिन-से-प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** She was fastidious about the cleanliness of her home, making sure every corner was spotless.
 

 
• **"Meticulous"** refers to showing great attention to detail; being very careful and precise. (बहुत सावधानीपूर्वक और बारीकी से काम करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist was meticulous in his work, spending hours perfecting every detail of the painting.
 

 
• Since both "Fastidious" and "Meticulous" emphasize attention to detail and care, **"Meticulous"** is the correct synonym for **"Fastidious"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Meticulous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Easygoing** (निश्चिंत, आसान): Relaxed and unconcerned about rules or details.
 
 
• **Example:** He has an easygoing attitude and never gets stressed about deadlines.
 

 
• **Indulgent** (सहिष्णु, उदार): Being overly lenient or permissive, often to satisfy someone's desires.
 
 
• **Example:** The indulgent grandparents spoiled their grandchildren with sweets and toys.
 

 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless mistake cost the team an important project.
